script:
CASE_FAILURE=0
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_STRING": "qa-f08-string-value"}}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_NUMBER": 5}}' \
  --expect 422 --save F08.secrets-bad-value/number || CASE_FAILURE=1
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_NULL": null}}' --expect 422 --save F08.secrets-bad-value/null || CASE_FAILURE=1
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_BOOL": true}}' --expect 422 --save F08.secrets-bad-value/bool || CASE_FAILURE=1
test "$CASE_FAILURE" -eq 0  # bug
